settings.visualStyle: AI-generated historical reenactment styled as black-and-white 35mm Stalingrad 1942-1943 wartime field-newsreel footage. Shattered brick streets, ruined factories, broken stairwells, smoke, dust, Soviet uniforms and period weapons. Moderate grain, gate weave, dust, scratches, frame flicker, soft optics and exposure breathing. Non-graphic combat only. No modern objects, HDR, drone, gimbal, glossy lighting or video-game framing.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. The camera belongs to a human wartime correspondent physically moving with the Soviet section through rubble, doorways, stairwells and factory interiors. The operator must share cover, squeeze through breaches, crouch behind machinery, hesitate at exposed streets, react late to shots, and allow walls, bodies, dust and debris to obstruct the lens. No dialogue, narration, subtitles or music. Diegetic sound only.
settings.customVisualStyle: Human-operated urban field-camera realism: cramped framing, shoulders and walls blocking the view, brick dust on lens edge, abrupt exposure change from street to dark interior, focus hunting in smoke, short unsteady runs, cautious peeks around corners and long breathy holds during lulls.

cameraPresenceLock.cameraOperator: anonymous wartime correspondent physically present with Soviet urban defenders

archivalLookLock.presentation: AI-generated reenactment with archival-style treatment; never claim genuine archive footage.
archivalLookLock.audioPolicy: No music, narration or intelligible dialogue. Diegetic sound only.

movie.plotDetails: A fictional Soviet infantryman anchors continuity while a physically present cameraman shares the same rooms, rubble and danger.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create a two-minute Stalingrad urban-combat reenactment as if a human wartime correspondent were physically embedded with one Soviet section. Camera must obey narrow corridors, rubble, walls, smoke, danger and human reaction time. Follow ruined streets, exposed crossing, factory entry, brief firefight, broken stairwell, wall breach, rubble crawl, exhaustion, overwatch and continued block-by-block movement. Black-and-white 35mm newsreel treatment. No dialogue, narration or music. Non-graphic and period accurate.
movie.storySummary: A Soviet rifleman moves through a shattered block and factory, climbs a broken stairwell, crawls across rubble, pauses in dusty cover, watches the street and moves on. The unseen cameraman records it from inside the same compressed environment, never from an impossible safe view.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP06 — Stalingrad: City of Fire

scenes.title: Street of Rubble
scenes.description: A shattered street opens beneath drifting smoke.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman walks with section through narrow rubble path.
scenes.imageDescription: Stalingrad ruin, broken masonry, Soviet infantry, smoke, black-and-white 35mm grain.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman walks immediately behind the section, stepping over bricks; camera dips toward footing then rises, shoulders and rubble intermittently block frame. Audio: boots on brick, distant artillery, falling debris.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator reaches exposed street gap behind lead soldier.

scenes.title: Across the Street
scenes.description: The squad crosses an exposed gap.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman sprints to cover behind a collapsed wall.
scenes.imageDescription: Exposed rubble street, smoke, troops running one by one.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator waits behind cover then follows a fraction late in one short sprint; heavy body bounce, brief loss of lead soldier behind another man, abrupt stop against wall. Audio: boots, gear, sharp distant fire, brick chips.

scenes.title: Into the Factory
scenes.description: The section enters a broken industrial shell.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman steps through jagged doorway into dim hall.
scenes.imageDescription: Destroyed factory, steel beams, broken windows, Soviet infantry entering.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman crosses doorway behind troops; exposure blooms from bright street then slowly darkens, frame brushes close to broken masonry and briefly loses focus. Audio: boots on debris, metal creak, distant gunfire.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator inside factory behind same section.

scenes.title: Fire Between Columns
scenes.description: A brief firefight erupts across industrial hall.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman crouches behind broken machine and fires.
scenes.imageDescription: Industrial ruin, broken machinery, smoke, non-graphic combat.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator ducks behind same machinery, lens partly blocked by metal edge and nearby shoulder. He leans only enough to catch controlled shots, then flinches back from return fire. Audio: rifle shots, echoes, metal impacts.

scenes.title: Broken Stairwell
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman climbs over missing steps and stops at landing.
scenes.imageDescription: Cracked stairwell, exposed brick, dust, broken rail.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman climbs behind him one careful step at a time, looking down at missing treads; frame tilts and jitters from unstable footing, wall fills one side. Audio: grit, boots, breath, distant shots.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator reaches half landing behind soldier.

scenes.title: Through the Breach
scenes.description: A blasted wall opening leads to another room.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman squeezes through opening while low.
scenes.imageDescription: Jagged brick breach, dim room, dust-coated soldier.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator squeezes through after him; bricks scrape close past lens, image partially occluded, camera rotates awkwardly sideways and corrects once clear. Audio: fabric scrape, brick grit, breathing.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera enters room behind same soldier.

scenes.title: Window Pause
scenes.description: The soldier listens before exposing himself to street.
scenes.actionDescription: He slowly leans enough to study road below.
scenes.imageDescription: Dark interior, shattered window, ruined street outside.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman stays farther back in shadow behind the soldier; window frame blocks much of view. One slow lean and cautious focus adjustment, no clean panoramic window shot. Audio: wind through glass, distant shots, breath.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator remains in shadow as section shifts.

scenes.title: Rubble Crawl
scenes.description: The section crosses collapsed interior low to ground.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman crawls over bricks and timber.
scenes.imageDescription: Ground-level rubble, timber, dust-coated soldier crawling.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman crawls too; lens 30-60 cm above rubble, brick dust touches lens edge, forearms and debris repeatedly fill frame. Audio: bricks shifting, fabric, breath, distant combat.

scenes.title: Dust and Breath
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman leans against pillar and catches breath.
scenes.imageDescription: Dusty hall, sunbeams, tired soldier, rifle low.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator also rests; near-still camera held against pillar with breathing sway and occasional dust drifting across focus. No cinematic push-in. Audio: breathing, distant artillery, loose metal tapping.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera remains beside pillar as movement resumes.

scenes.title: Back Through Machinery
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman follows comrades through machinery.
scenes.imageDescription: Large ruined factory interior, smoke, damaged machines.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman threads behind them; machines repeatedly block view and force side-steps, causing short imperfect reframes. Audio: boots, gear, metal creaks, distant fire.

scenes.title: Street Overwatch
scenes.description: The soldier watches smoke-filled street from upper opening.
scenes.actionDescription: He scans left to right across street below.
scenes.imageDescription: Elevated broken building view, rubble street, distant movement.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator stays behind cover at same human height, panning only through narrow window gap; wall edges remain visible and limit field of view. Audio: wind, distant engines, sporadic shots.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera pulls back from window after soldier.

scenes.title: Down to the Street
scenes.description: The unit descends and emerges into another lane.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman follows section through doorway to street.
scenes.imageDescription: Ruined lane, smoke, soldier emerging low.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman follows through dark doorway; exposure briefly blows out in bright smoke outside, another soldier blocks frame, then image settles. Audio: boots, wind, distant combat.

scenes.title: No Safe Corner
scenes.description: The soldier checks a ruined corner.
scenes.actionDescription: He leans around corner then motions unit onward.
scenes.imageDescription: Broken brick corner, shattered doorway, smoke beyond.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman remains one body length behind, seeing only partial angle around soldier. One cautious lean, quick return, small focus correction. Audio: loose brick, breathing, distant gunfire.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera follows section toward wider block.

scenes.title: City of Fire
scenes.description: A wider view reveals several ruined blocks.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman stops beside rubble while scale opens ahead.
scenes.imageDescription: Wide Stalingrad ruins, smoke columns, tiny infantry figures.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator climbs only onto a small rubble step beside the soldier, gaining a modest human-height reveal; breathing and unstable rubble cause slight sway. No crane or rooftop omniscient view. Audio: wind, artillery, scattered fires.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera steps down behind moving unit.

scenes.title: Block by Block
scenes.description: The section disappears around another corner.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman follows unit out of sight.
scenes.imageDescription: Long ruined street corridor, soldiers receding through smoke.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman remains behind from fatigue and holds at shoulder height as troops vanish around rubble; smoke and passing dust partially obscure them. No cinematic pull-back. Audio: boots, wind, distant gunfire only.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Final frame holds on empty smoky corner.

characters.name: Urban Defender
characters.description: Anonymous Soviet infantryman in historically plausible Stalingrad-era gear, increasingly coated in brick dust.

continuity.continuityRules: Keep same face, helmet, rifle and uniform. Brick dust and grime increase and persist.
